bounded_statement: The selected result claims an occurrence rate for the entire 96-station scheduled survey network but divides the 18 observed occurrences only by the 72 stations retained after screening, excluding 24 scheduled stations from the exposure denominator.

counterevidence_considered.description: The omitted stations have unassessed occurrence values, which could support a separately stated retained-subset estimand; however, the visible task and selected claim do not state that conditional estimand.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Stations omitted by the signal screen: 24
Occurrences observed among the retained stations: 18

evidence.description: The stated task requires one occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network.

source_refs.quoted_text: Build a compact coastal-station workflow that reports one occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network.

evidence.description: The report defines the target population as all 96 scheduled stations while accounting for only 72 retained stations and 24 omitted stations.

source_refs.quoted_text: Target population: all 96 scheduled coastal stations in the survey network.

Scheduled stations (planned units): 96
Stations passing the signal screen: 72
Stations omitted by the signal screen: 24

evidence.description: The selected result explicitly labels its claim as covering the entire scheduled network but uses the 72 retained stations as its denominator.

source_refs.quoted_text:
Exposure denominator: the 72 stations retained after the signal screen.
[selected-result] Occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network: 18 occurrences divided by 72 retained stations = 0.25 (25.00 occurrences per 100 stations).

evidence.description: The workflow directly constructs the complete-network claim using SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS as the divisor.

source_refs.quoted_text:
DENOMINATOR_LINE = f'Exposure denominator: the {SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS} stations retained after the signal screen.' + LF
SELECTED_LINE = f'[selected-result] Occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network: {OBSERVED_OCCURRENCES} occurrences divided by {SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS} retained stations = {SELECTED_RATE_FRACTION} ({SELECTED_RATE_PERCENT} occurrences per 100 stations).' + LF

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify the issue by checking whether the 18/72 result was explicitly conditional on passing the screen or whether an approved target change justified excluding the 24 omitted stations. Instead, the report calls the target all 96 stations, calls 18/72 the rate for the entire network, and states that no approved method deviation exists.

root_cause: The workflow sets the selected denominator to SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS and interpolates that retained-subset count into a result labeled as applying to the entire scheduled survey network.
